story.summaryZh: 哈斯车队车手安东内利感谢团队在墨西哥城大奖赛中的努力，尽管连续两天更换引擎，但车队从未错过任何练习。

story.originalTitle: "I’d like to thank the team for all their hard work and effort, as we’ve had engine changes both days in a short space of time and never missed a se...
story.summaryEn:
"I’d like to thank the team for all their hard work and effort, as we’ve had engine changes both days in a short space of time and never missed a session, so that’s a great effort." 🗣️ AK
Saturday wrapped up in Mexico City 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
“我想感谢团队所有人的辛勤工作和努力，因为我们在这短短的时间内两天都进行了引擎更换，并且从未错过任何一节练习，这是巨大的努力。” 🗣️ AK
周六在墨西哥城结束 🇲🇽
#哈斯F1 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
"I’d like to thank the team for all their hard work and effort, as we’ve had engine changes both days in a short space of time and never missed a session, so that’s a great effort." 🗣️ AK
Saturday wrapped up in Mexico City 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP

relatedItems.summaryEn:
"I think the baseline is good, and it’s now at the fine-tuning stage of understanding what we can do better on the medium and hard compounds, and at the same time, getting a bit more out of the soft tire." 🗣️ AK
Wrapping up Friday in São Paulo 🇧🇷
#HaasF1 #F1 #BrazilGP
detailZh:
“我认为基础线很好，现在正处于调整阶段，了解我们可以在中硬胎上做得更好的地方，同时，从软胎上得到更多。” 🗣️ AK
在圣保罗结束周五的比赛 🇧🇷
#HaasF1 #F1 #巴西大奖赛
detailEn:
